enabled.description: Enable the parprouted service to start automatically at boot.

interfaces.description: List of interface pairs to bridge. Each item specifies an input interface and an output interface (both must exist and be up). parprouted requires these interfaces to have IP addresses assigned.

options.description: Extra command-line arguments to pass to the parprouted binary. Supported switches include: -d (debugging, stay in foreground), -p (permanent ARP entries, no refreshing).
